title: Aureline M5 status-transition sheet
description: Canonical reusable status-transition sheet. Previews the side effects of a transition before write — a local-only transition, a publish-now transition, open in provider, a comment side effect, a status side effect, or a blocked transition — so a user never has to infer whether a transition is only local or publishes to the provider. Governed by the M5 work-item component matrix in crates/aureline-provider.
